'''Besero''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> situated in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core's]] [[Besero system/Legends|Besero system]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Besero was the site of pitch-[[Color/Legends|black]] [[lumni-mine]]s, with dark rumors and mutterings spreading about the world.<ref name="TEA" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Tagge Mining Company|Tagge Mining Corporation]] caused many problems for the [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]] of Besero.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Besero was first mentioned in [[Bill Smith]]'s [[1992]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|Second Edition core rulebook]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, the world is mentioned in a hypothetical gameplay example where the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] player character [[Tirog]], who is employed by the Tagge Mining Corporation, visits Besero. In the example, Tirog's affiliation causes problems for him when dealing with the world's bureaucracy.<ref name="RPG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Besero in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA" />
